name: Biriba
description: Biriba (Μπιρίμπα) is Greece's most popular card game, a rich and strategic partnership rummy game. Played with two decks and four Jokers, it challenges players to form sets and runs, including at least one 'biriba' (a 7-card meld), to go out. The game is famous for its 'pot' mechanic, where players pick up a reserve hand once they empty their initial deal. It combines the deep calculation of Burraco with the high-speed timing of Canasta.

content.text: Biriba (Μπιρίμπα) is Greece's most popular card game, a rich and strategic partnership rummy game. Played with two decks and four Jokers, it challenges players to form sets and runs, including at least one 'biriba' (a 7-card meld), to go out. The game is famous for its 'pot' mechanic, where players pick up a reserve hand once they empty their initial deal. It combines the deep calculation of Burraco with the high-speed timing of Canasta.

Believed to be derived from Italian Burraco or early Canasta variants, Biriba developed into a unique national pastime in Greece and Cyprus during the mid-20th century. It is a staple of Greek coffeehouse (kafeneia) culture.
4 players in two fixed partnerships (North-South vs East-West).
108 cards: Two standard 52-card decks plus four Jokers. Jokers and 2s are wild.
Standard pack with jokers, score pad.
Deal 11 cards to each player. Two 'pots' (reserve hands) of 11 cards each are placed face down. Remaining cards form the stock.

items.text: Runs Only (No Sets): Only suit sequences are allowed; rank-based sets are prohibited, making the game much harder.
